Title: Name changes and GUID migration: Azure SQL Data Warehouse Gen1 US Government

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Data Warehouse is a fast, familiar, and flexible analytics platform for enterprises.

Effective July 1, 2018, to reflect the key investments and capability updates, "SQL Data Warehouse" will be renamed to "Compute Optimized Gen1." There will be no pricing impact from this name change.

Also, US DoD customers will see a new resource GUID for their existing workloads. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change either, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names or resource GUIDs.
